summary: Hermite cubic interpolation between four input float pairs (a4-a7) using SSE intrinsics. Computes t^2 and t^3 from parameter t (a8), evaluates a cubic basis polynomial via precomputed spline coefficient constants (xmmword_5D8A50/60/70/80), blends the four inputs with the resulting basis values, and stores the interleaved result at output pointer a3. Straight-line, unconditional, no callees.

local_names.a3: output pointer to interleaved float pairs

operations.description: Square interpolation parameter t=a8 into a1, yielding t^2.
Compute t^3 = t * t^2 into a2.
Evaluate the cubic basis polynomial at t via SSE multiply-accumulate: constant term xmmword_5D8A60, t term xmmword_5D8A80, t^2 term xmmword_5D8A70, t^3 term xmmword_5D8A50; result held in v9.
Blend the four input float pairs a4, a5, a6, a7 using the four scalar basis values broadcast from v9 via shuffles; result held in v10.
Store high 64 bits of v10 to output pointer a3 as a double, and store the low 32 bits of v10 at a3+8, producing the interleaved float-pair output.
